gloss: hitting the nail on the head; a guess that is exactly right

definitions.gloss: hitting the nail on the head; guessing exactly right
definitions.explanation: A remark or guess that lands precisely on the truth — usually one the other person was hoping to hide. Originally the black bull's-eye of an archery target. Nearly always used in the fixed phrases {図星|ずぼし}だ and {図星|ずぼし}を{指|さ}す.

examples.japanese: {図星|ずぼし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}されて→指す：02056_sasu⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{言|い}えなかった→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: They hit the nail on the head and I couldn't say a thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{黙|だま}って→黙る：02287_damaru⟧しまった⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧やら{図星|ずぼし}だったらしい。
examples.english: Judging by how she went quiet, it seems I'd guessed right.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れている→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ではないか→ではないか：30627_dehanaika⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧、{図星|ずぼし}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{苦笑|くしょう}い⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When they asked if I was tired, they were exactly right, so I gave a wry smile.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {図星|ずぼし}だ: that's exactly right (usually said of someone else's guess about you)
- {図星|ずぼし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}す→指す：02056_sasu⟧: to hit the nail on the head
- {図星|ずぼし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}される→指す：02056_sasu⟧: to be seen right through

USAGE:
The word carries a sense of being caught out, so it usually appears where the truth was inconvenient — an evasion detected, a feeling one was hiding. Saying {図星|ずぼし}だ about oneself is a light-hearted admission. From archery: the {図星|ずぼし} was the mark at the center of the target.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦その{通|とお}り→その通り：22252_sonotoori⟧: exactly so — plain agreement, with none of the caught-out nuance
- ⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧: a hit, correct — used for quizzes and guesses generally, without the sense of exposure
